diagnosis.summary: The nightly run 86ef5236 for 2026-10-01 failed at the ingest step because upstream never delivered the order_items file for that day (landing/order_items/dt=2026-10-01/order_items.csv). The orders and payments files for that day are present and valid. This looks like a one-off export glitch, so I've proposed asking upstream to resend orders, order_items and payments for 2026-10-01, then rerunning the partition.

root_cause.explanation: The upstream export did not deliver order_items.csv for dt=2026-10-01, so ingest raised IngestError. The orders file (440 rows) and payments file (417 rows) for that day are present, match the contract and have no parse errors. order_items loaded normally on every earlier day, which points to a one-off delivery failure rather than a deliberate upstream change.

proposal.rationale: Ingest failed because the upstream export never delivered landing/order_items/dt=2026-10-01/order_items.csv. The orders and payments files for that day are present and look normal (same headers as the contract, normal row counts, no parse errors). order_items arrived every earlier day. This is a one-off delivery glitch, so per the runbook we ask for redelivery of the related tables together (orders, order_items, payments) to keep them consistent with each other, then rerun the partition.
